blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Detecting violence after it begins is important from recognizing behavioral cues that appear immediately beforehand. This work studies short-horizon pre-incident risk recognition from multimodal video signals. We construct a binary Normal-versus-Risky setting from temporally annotated XD-Violence clips, using 443 samples with source-level separation across training, validation, and test sets. Each sample consists of a variable-length pre-incident clip, with its duration determined by the observable behavioral context preceding the incident. The incident itself is excluded from all input clips. We evaluate three complementary information sources: facial-region appearance, temporally aligned audio, and body-motion features derived from tracked keypoints. Controlled ablations are performed with Swin-Tiny, ViT-Tiny, and DeiT-Tiny to measure the contribution of each modality under the same split. Results show that combining all modalities is more effective than using any other combination alone. The best configuration, Deit-Tiny with audio, facial appearance, and motion, achieves 91.21% accuracy, 88.96% balanced accuracy, 93.65% F1-score, and 96.38% ROC-AUC on the held-out test set. These results suggest that complementary appearance, acoustic, and kinematic cues provide useful evidence for recognizing elevated pre-incident risk.
blocks.zh: 在暴力开始后发现暴力,重要的是要识别立即出现的行为提示。 这项工作研究了多式联运视频信号对事故前风险的短期识别。 我们利用443个样本,在培训、验证和测试组合中进行源层分离,从时间标注的XD-暴力片段构建一个二进制常态对Risky设置。 每个样本由一个可变长的事故前剪辑组成,其持续时间由事件发生前可观察到的行为背景决定. 事件本身被排除在所有输入片段之外. 我们评价三个互补的信息来源:面部-区域外观,时空对齐的音频,以及从跟踪关键点衍生出来的身体运动特征. 与Swin-Tiny、ViT-Tiny和DeiT-Tiny一起进行可控调剂,以衡量在相同拆分下每种模式的贡献。 结果表明,将所有模式结合起来比单独使用任何其他组合更为有效。 最佳配置Deit-Tiny配有音频,面部外观和运动,实现91.21%的精度,88.96%的平衡精度,93.65%的F1-分数,96.38%的ROC-AUC在停机测试集上. 这些结果表明,相辅的外观、声学和动能提示为识别高发事故前风险提供了有益的证据。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Violent incidents in public and monitored environments can escalate rapidly, leaving only a short window for timely intervention. Automated video understanding has therefore become increasingly important for applications such as public-space surveillance, transportation hubs, campuses, healthcare facilities, and online video moderation, where continuous human monitoring is often impractical. Existing video anomaly and violence-detection methods have made substantial progress in recognizing fights, assaults, shootings, and other abnormal events, supported by large-scale benchmarks such as UCF-Crime and XD-Violence [ 17 , 22 ] . Multimodal approaches further improve recognition by combining complementary visual, motion, and audio cues, particularly when the visual stream is degraded by occlusion or poor illumination [ 22 , 14 , 21 ] . However, these systems, including online variants that operate causally, are designed to recognize violent or anomalous evidence already present in the observed sequence. For safety-critical applications, a complementary question is whether observable behavior before an incident can distinguish emerging risk from normal activity.
blocks.zh: 公共和受监测环境中的暴力事件可能迅速升级,为及时干预留下了短暂的窗口。 因此,对于公共空间监测、交通枢纽、校园、保健设施和在线视频节制等应用而言,自动视频理解已变得日益重要,而人类持续监测往往不切实际。 现有视频异常和暴力探测方法在识别战斗、攻击、枪击和其他异常事件方面取得了实质性进展,并得到了UCF-Crime和XD-violence等大规模基准的支持[17、22]。 多式联运方法通过将互补的视觉、运动和音频提示结合起来,进一步提高了认识,特别是在视觉流因闭塞或照明差而退化时[22、14、21]。 然而,这些系统,包括因果运行的在线变体,旨在识别观测序列中已经存在的暴力或异常证据。 就安全关键应用而言,一个补充的问题是,在事故发生之前是否可观察到的行为能够区分新出现的风险和正常活动。

blocks.en: Recent work has expanded violence detection beyond single visual streams by incorporating complementary audio, motion, and semantic information. Following the audio-visual XD-Violence benchmark [ 22 ] , attention-based fusion methods modeled cross-modal interactions between visual and audio features through co-attention and bilinear or additive fusion [ 14 , 21 ] . Other work added caption-derived textual features to audio-visual input and strengthened multi-scale temporal modeling [ 13 ] . More recent methods improve cross-modal interaction through semantic feature alignment that also addresses modality asynchrony [ 10 ] and through gated fusion combined with multi-scale temporal modeling [ 1 ] . Although these approaches improve multimodal violence recognition, they are trained and evaluated to score frames that already contain violent evidence; pre-incident frames are treated as negatives, so early responses are counted as false alarms rather than as anticipation.
blocks.zh: 最近的工作通过纳入补充性音频、运动和语义信息,将暴力探测范围扩大到单一视觉流以外。 按照视听XD-暴力基准[22],基于注意力的聚变方法通过共心和双线或添加剂聚变,模拟视觉和音频特征之间的交叉模式互动[14,21]. 其他工作在视听投入中增加了字幕衍生的文字特征,并加强了多尺度的时间模型[13]。 较新的方法通过语义特征对齐,同时处理同步式[10],并通过门式聚变结合多尺度时间模型[1],改善跨模式的相互作用. 虽然这些方法提高了对多式联运暴力的识别,但经过培训和评价,可以对已经包含暴力证据的帧进行计分;事件前帧被视为负数,因此早期反应被算作虚假警报而不是预期。

blocks.en:
Treating early responses as anticipation requires a different formulation, where the model must make a decision using only behavior observed before violent evidence appears. This problem has received less attention, although human observers have been shown to anticipate dangerous CCTV incidents above chance [ 20 ] . Blunsden and Fisher studied pre-fight
recognition using spatio-temporal cuboid features and hierarchical AdaBoost [ 2 ] . They showed that pre-segmented pre-fight sequences could be distinguished from normal, fight, and post-fight behavior. However, performance dropped on continuous video, where pre-fight frames were often confused with normal activity or fighting. Their continuous classifier also used a temporal window centered on the current frame, which could include observations after incident onset, and the evaluation was based on acted
scenarios. Most recent violence-detection methods are still mainly reactive and are trained
to recognize violence once it is already visible in the observed
sequence [ 14 , 21 , 13 , 10 , 1 ] .
This leaves an important gap: whether modern learned representations of human
behavior can recognize short-horizon risk using only observations captured
before an incident begins.
blocks.zh:
将早期反应视为预期需要一种不同的表述,即模型必须使用暴力证据出现前观察到的行为作出决定。 这个问题没有受到什么重视,尽管已经显示,人类观察家预测到的闭路电视危险事件可能超过[20]. Blunsden和Fisher研究了战斗前
使用螺旋-时空立体特征和等级AdaBoost[2]进行识别。 他们表明,预分战前的序列可以与正常,战斗,以及战斗后的行为区分开来. 然而,表现却在连续的视频中下降,在视频中,战斗前的帧往往与正常的活动或战斗相混淆. 他们的连续分类器还使用了一个以当前框架为中心的时间窗口,其中可以包括事件发生后的观测结果,评价基于行动

这就留下了一个重要的空白:现代学问是否表现了人类
行为可以只使用捕获的观测数据识别短视风险

blocks.en: To address this gap, we study pre-incident risk recognition using only observations captured before annotated incident onset. The incident itself is excluded from the input, distinguishing our setting from event-present violence detection. We examine complementary cues from facial appearance, audio context, and pose-derived body motion, and evaluate them individually and in combination across multiple transformer backbones. Our objective is not to infer latent human intent, but to determine whether observable cues preceding an incident provide useful evidence of near-term risk.
blocks.zh: 为了弥补这一差距,我们只利用在附带说明的事件发生前获得的观察,研究事故前风险识别。 事件本身被排除在投入之外,将我们的背景与事件现场的暴力探测区分开来。 我们从面部外观,音频背景, 和姿势产生的身体运动来检查辅助提示, 通过多个变压器骨干单独和组合地评价它们。 我们的目标不是推断潜在的人类意图,而是确定事故发生前的可观测提示是否提供了近期风险的有用证据。

blocks.en: • We formulate pre-incident risk recognition as a setting in which models observe only behavior captured before annotated incident onset, and curate a dataset of pre-onset clips with graded risk annotations. • We evaluate facial, audio, and body-motion cues individually and in combination across multiple transformer backbones to measure the contribution of each source. • We show that multimodal behavioral cues observed before incident onset carry discriminative evidence of near-term risk, supporting proactive rather than reactive violence analysis.
blocks.zh: • 支助 我们制定事件前风险识别,作为模型只观察附加说明的事件发生前所记录的行为的设定,并管理一套带有分级风险说明的设定前短片。 我们通过多个变压器骨干单独或组合评估面部、音频和体动提示,以衡量每个源的贡献。 我们显示,在事件发生前观察到的多模式行为提示带有近期风险的歧视性证据,支持主动而不是被动的暴力分析。

The remainder of this paper is organized as follows.
Section 2 reviews prior work on video anomaly detection, multimodal violence
recognition, feature fusion, and event anticipation.
Section 3 presents the task formulation, multimodal representations, and
fusion framework.
Section 4 describes the dataset curation, experimental setup, ablation studies,
results, and discussions.
Finally, Section 5 concludes the paper.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
In this section, we review prior work on weakly supervised anomaly detection, multimodal violence recognition, generalizable video anomaly detection, and
event anticipation.
blocks.zh:
在本节中,我们回顾以前在以下领域开展的工作:监督不力的异常现象检测、多式联运暴力识别、普遍视频异常现象检测,以及
事件预测。

blocks.en: 2.1 Weakly Supervised Video Anomaly and Violence Detection
blocks.zh: 2.1 监督不力的视频异常和暴力检测

blocks.en: Weakly supervised video anomaly detection learns temporal abnormality from video-level labels without requiring dense frame annotations. Sultani et al. [ 17 ] introduced the UCF-Crime benchmark and a multiple-instance learning formulation for anomaly detection in long, untrimmed videos. Wu et al. [ 22 ] extended this setting to audio-visual violence detection through XD-Violence, while RTFM [ 18 ] improved temporal anomaly localization using feature-magnitude learning. These methods provide important foundations for violence and anomaly recognition, but primarily identify abnormal evidence within the observed video.
blocks.zh: 弱监督的视频异常检测从视频级别标签中学习到时间异常,而不需要密集的帧说明. 苏尔塔尼等人. [17] 引入了UCF-Crime基准和多层学习配方,用于在长片,无线视频中检测异常. 吴等. [22]通过XD-暴力将这一设定扩展至视听暴力探测,而RTFM [18] 利用特征放大学习改进了时间异常定位. 这些方法为暴力和异常识别提供了重要的基础,但主要是在所观察到的视频中识别异常证据.

blocks.en: 2.2 Multimodal Violence Detection
blocks.zh: 2.2 发现多种暴力

blocks.en: Multimodal violence detection has largely been developed on XD-Violence, combining visual features with audio and, in some methods, optical flow or generated captions. Methods differ mainly in how modalities interact, including co-attention and bilinear fusion [ 14 ] , stacked self- and co-attention units [ 21 ] , caption-augmented multi-scale temporal networks [ 13 ] , sparse alignment of audio and flow into the RGB feature space [ 10 ] , and gated fusion with multi-scale bottleneck transformers [ 1 ] . Graph-based fusion operators have also been proposed for integrating heterogeneous features in video anomaly detection [ 6 ] . Across these methods, the emphasis is on how violent evidence is combined across modalities once it is present, rather than on what the modalities reveal beforehand.
blocks.zh: 以XD-暴力为主的多式暴力侦测工作基本得到发展,将视觉特征与音频相结合,某些方法还包括光学流或生成的字幕。 方法主要在模式的相互作用上有所不同,包括共通和双线式聚变[14],堆叠的自通和共通单元[21],字幕加载的多尺度时间网络[13],音频和流入RGB特性空间的零散对齐[10],以及加载多尺度瓶颈变压器的门式聚变. [1]. 还提议以图为基础的聚变操作员将各种特性纳入视频异常探测[6]。 在整个这些方法中,重点是暴力证据一旦出现,如何将各种模式结合起来,而不是这些模式事先揭示的内容。

blocks.en: 2.3 Video Anomaly Detection
blocks.zh: 2.3 视频异常检测

blocks.en: Recent studies have also sought to make anomaly detection transfer beyond fixed training categories, often by leveraging vision-language models. [ 9 ] identifies local spatial patterns through image-text alignment to generalize to novel anomalies, and LaGoVAD [ 12 ] allows anomaly definitions to be specified in natural language at inference time for open-world detection. SteerVAD [ 3 ] instead steers anomaly-sensitive attention heads within a frozen multimodal large language model, achieving competitive performance with little training data. Because these methods ground anomalies in semantic descriptions of the event itself, they broaden what can be detected but do not address the behavior that precedes an incident.
blocks.zh: 最近的研究还力求使异常探测转移超越固定的培训类别,往往利用视觉语言模式。 [9]通过图像文本对齐来识别局部空间图案,以概括到新奇异常,LaGOVAD[12]允许在推断时间用自然语言指定异常定义用于开放世界检测. SingleVAD [3] 转而将异常敏感注意头放在一个冻结的多式联运大语言模型中,在几乎没有培训数据的情况下实现竞争性能. 由于这些方法在对事件本身的语义描述中地面异常,它们拓宽了可以检测到的事物,但没有涉及事件发生前的行为.

blocks.en: 2.4 Action and Anomaly Anticipation
blocks.zh: 2.4 行动和异常预测

blocks.en: Anticipation methods infer upcoming events from preceding observations. The Anticipative Video Transformer [ 8 ] predicts next actions in egocentric video, and [ 4 ] introduced video anomaly anticipation as a task, together with the semi-supervised NWPU Campus benchmark and a model that jointly detects and anticipates anomalies. More recently, PULS [ 16 ] predicts future latent states with a video world model and reports an anticipatory advantage shortly before anomaly onset on UCF-Crime and XD-Violence. For violence specifically, [ 5 ] fuse visual, audio, and caption features and add a Siamese onset branch that models transitional dynamics around violence onset, while earlier work by [ 2 ] classified pre-fight behavior using hand-crafted features.
blocks.zh: 预测方法从先前的观察推断出即将发生的事件。 Anticipiant Video Transformer [8] 预言了以自我为中心的视频中的下一步行动,[4] 将视频异常预测作为一项任务,连同半监督的NWPU Campus基准和一个联合检测和预测异常的模型. 最近,PULS [16] 以视频世界模型预测未来的潜在状态,并报告说,在 UCF-Crime and XD-violence异常爆发前不久,UCF-Criminal and XD-violence具有预期优势。 特别针对暴力,[5] 将视觉、音频和字幕功能连接起来,并增加一个暹罗发作分支,以模拟暴力发作的过渡动态,而早期的工作则由[2]利用手工制作的特征对战斗前行为进行分类。

blocks.en: Our work differs from these approaches in three respects. First, in contrast to onset-aware detection, our inputs end before annotated onset and never include the incident itself. Second, whereas prior anomaly anticipation relies on generic scene representations, we focus on human-centered cues, namely facial appearance, audio, and body motion, and measure the contribution of each. Finally, rather than semi-supervised benchmarks recorded in fixed campus scenes, our clips are drawn from diverse, unconstrained XD-Violence videos spanning movies and in-the-wild footage, and are annotated with graded pre-incident risk.
blocks.zh: 我们的工作在三个方面不同于这些办法。 第一,与发觉探测不同,我们的投入在发觉前就结束了,而且从未包括事故本身。 其次,之前的异常预测依赖于一般的场景表现,而我们则侧重于以人为中心的提示,即面部外观,音频和身体运动,并衡量每个场景的贡献. 最后,我们的剪辑并非半监督的基准记录在固定的校园场景中,而是从各种不受约束的XD暴力视频中抽取,这些视频横跨电影和杂乱无章的片段,并附有分级事件前风险的注释.

blocks.en: 3 Methodology
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en:
We formulate pre-incident recognition as binary clip classification using
three synchronized modalities: facial appearance, audio, and pose-derived
motion. As illustrated in Figure 1 , each modality is encoded
independently, and the resulting clip-level representations are combined
through late feature fusion to predict either Normal or Risky .

三种同步模式:面部外观、音频和姿势
移动。 如图1所示,每种模式都有编码。

通过后期特性聚变来预测正常或风险.

blocks.en:
Figure 1 : Overview of the proposed multimodal pre-incident risk classification framework.
The preprocessing stage maps XD-Violence source videos into binary Normal and Risky
clips and aligns facial appearance, audio, and pose-derived motion inputs.
The facial stream uses a pretrained visual backbone followed by a temporal Transformer,
the audio stream processes log-magnitude spectrograms using a three-stage CNN, and the
motion stream models pose-derived kinematic features using a temporal Transformer.
The resulting 256-dimensional visual, 128-dimensional audio, and 64-dimensional motion
representations are concatenated and passed through a late-fusion classification head
to predict Normal or Risky behavior.

blocks.en: 3.1 Input Construction
blocks.zh: 3.1 投入建筑

blocks.en: For each annotated clip, we sample T = 32 T=32 ordered frames at 8 8 frames per second from an observation window ending at the clip boundary. This corresponds to a maximum duration of approximately four seconds. Shorter sequences are padded, and a validity mask prevents padded positions from contributing to temporal attention. Audio and motion features are extracted from the same interval.
blocks.zh: 对于每个注解片段,我们从片段边界结束的观察窗口中抽取T = 32 T = 32个订购帧,每秒8个帧. 这相当于最长持续时间约4秒. 更短的序列是加成的,一个有效性面具可以防止加成位置对时间的注意. 音频和运动特性从同一个间隔中提取.

Learned positional embeddings preserve frame order, while a classification token produces the final facial representation 𝐞 v ∈ ℝ 256 \mathbf{e}_{v}\in\mathbb{R}^{256} . blocks.en: Facial regions are localized using the available COCO-17 pose annotations. blocks.en: 3.3 Audio Stream
blocks.zh: 3.3 音频流

blocks.en: Audio is converted to mono, resampled to 16 ​ kHz 16\,\mathrm{kHz} , normalized, and aligned with the visual observation window. We compute a standardized log-magnitude spectrogram using a 512-point short-time Fourier transform, a 400-sample Hann window, and a 160-sample hop.

Adaptive average pooling produces a 128-dimensional audio representation 𝐞 a ∈ ℝ 128 \mathbf{e}_{a}\in\mathbb{R}^{128} . blocks.en: COCO-17 keypoints extracted by the YOLO pose [ 15 ] estimator are used to calculate 12 kinematic descriptors: mean and maximum speed, acceleration, and jerk; speed dispersion; mean and maximum wrist and ankle speeds; and overall keypoint-motion energy.

blocks.en: Motion measurements are normalized by body scale and aggregated across detected people using permutation-invariant mean and maximum statistics. A one-layer temporal Transformer with four attention heads produces the clip-level motion representation 𝐞 m ∈ ℝ 64 \mathbf{e}_{m}\in\mathbb{R}^{64} . blocks.en: 4 Experiments and Results
blocks.zh: 4 实验和结果

blocks.en: We evaluate the proposed framework using curated pre-incident clips from XD-Violence. The experiments examine the contribution of facial appearance, audio, and body motion, and compare different visual backbones under the same data partitions. We also provide qualitative visualizations to better understand the information captured by each modality.
blocks.zh: 我们利用XD-暴力的预案片段来评价拟议框架。 实验考察了面部外观,音频,和身体运动的作用,并在同一个数据分区下比较不同的视觉骨干. 我们还提供定性的可视化,以更好地了解每种方式所获取的信息。

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en:
The experimental set was constructed from the XD-Violence
dataset [ 22 ] . Source videos were manually reviewed to identify behavior occurring before a violent incident. For each Risky example, only the portion preceding the incident was retained, while the incident itself was excluded from the model input. Because the amount of observable pre-incident behavior varies across videos, the resulting clips have variable
durations.
blocks.zh:
实验用XD-暴力建造
数据集 [22]. 对原始录像进行了人工审查,以查明暴力事件前的行为。 对于每一个"风险"的例子,只保留了事件前的部分,而事件本身被排除在模型输入之外. 由于可观测到的事件前行为的数量因视频而异,因此产生的片段具有可变性.
期限。

blocks.en:
Each clip was manually categorized as No Risk , Low Risk , Medium Risk , or High Risk using visual appearance, body motion, and audio context. For binary classification, Low, Medium, and High-Risk clips were grouped into the Risky class, while No-Risk clips formed the Normal class. Clips originating from the same source
video were kept within a single training, validation, or test partition to avoid information leakage. These labels represent observable pre-incident behavioral cues and are not intended to contain violence frames.
blocks.zh:
每个片段都采用视觉外观、身体运动和音频背景,被人工分类为无风险、低风险、中风险或高风险。 对于二进制分类,Low,Medium,和High-Risk剪辑被分组为Risky类,而No-Risk剪辑则组成了Normal类. 来自同一来源的剪贴板
录像保存在单一的培训、验证或测试分区内,以避免信息泄漏。 这些标签代表了可观察到的事件前行为提示,并非意在包含暴力框架.

blocks.zh: 4.2 结果和失望

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: This work examined whether multimodal behavioral cues observed before annotated incident onset can support short-horizon pre-incident risk recognition. By combining facial appearance, synchronized audio, and pose-derived motion, the framework captures complementary information about appearance, acoustic context, and body dynamics rather than relying on a single source of evidence. The experimental results show that multimodal integration provided better results, with the three-modality DeiT-Tiny configuration achieving the strongest overall performance of 91.21% accuracy, 88.96% balanced accuracy, 93.65% F1-score, and 96.38% ROC-AUC on the held-out test set. These findings suggest that useful discriminative information can be present in the period preceding an incident, highlighting the potential of moving violence analysis beyond event-present detection toward earlier risk recognition. In future work, we plan to expand the dataset with more diverse pre-incident scenarios and develop a more robust multimodal model capable of capturing temporal relationships across modalities and recognizing risk earlier and more reliably before incident onset.
blocks.zh: 这项工作审查了在附带说明的事件发生前观察到的多式联运行为提示是否能够支持短期事故前风险识别。 通过组合面部外观,同步音频,和姿势衍生的运动,框架捕捉关于外观,声学背景,和身体动力学的补充信息,而不是依赖单一的证据来源. 实验结果表明,多式联运集成提供了更好的结果,三模式DeiT-Tiny配置实现了91.21%的精度、88.96%的平衡精度、93.65%的F1-分数和96.38%的ROC-AUC在停产测试中最强的整体性能。 这些调查结果表明,在事件发生之前的期间可以提供有用的歧视性信息,这突出表明了将暴力分析从事件现场发现转移到更早的风险识别的可能性。 在今后的工作中,我们计划扩大数据集,采用更加多样化的事故前情景,并开发一个更强有力的多式联运模式,能够捕捉各种模式之间的时间关系,在事件发生前更早和更可靠地认识到风险。

仍有少量困难或有把握地不正确的案件。

blocks.en:
Figure 6 : Distribution of predicted Risky probabilities for Normal and Risky clips
in the held-out test set. Most Normal clips receive scores near zero,
whereas most Risky clips receive scores near one, showing clear separation
between the two classes. The dashed line indicates the fixed classification
threshold of 0.5 0.5 . Blue observations to the right of the threshold
correspond to false positives, while orange observations to the left
correspond to false negatives.

blocks.en:
Table 2 summarizes the annotation criteria used to assign
the four original risk levels. The labels are based on observable cues across
visual appearance, body motion, and audio. No-Risk clips contain stable and
non-aggressive behavior, while Low- and Medium-Risk clips represent
progressively stronger behavioral changes and escalation. High-Risk clips
contain stronger pre-incident cues occurring close to the annotated incident
onset. For the binary experiments, Low-, Medium-, and High-Risk clips are
grouped into the Risky class, while No-Risk clips form the Normal class.
